news.title: Parliament passes new coalition budget after overnight vote
news.text: The lower house passed the coalition budget by 212 votes to 198 after an overnight session. The plan raises defence spending by 4 percent and freezes fuel duty for a year. Opposition parties said they would challenge parts of it in court. The finance minister said the budget keeps the deficit under 3 percent of output, in line with the bloc's rules. Markets reacted calmly, with the benchmark bond yield little changed on the day. The upper house votes next week and is expected to approve it without changes.

news.title: Ceasefire talks resume in Geneva with new mediators
news.text: Delegations returned to Geneva on Monday for a third round of ceasefire talks, with Swiss and Omani mediators now leading the sessions. Officials said the main sticking point is control of the border crossing, which carries about 40 percent of aid deliveries. A pause in fighting held for a fourth day, the longest since the spring. Diplomats cautioned that a deal could still take weeks.
